title: Support Queue Shows Newest Tickets First
description:
`sort_oldest_first(tickets)` should return support tickets sorted so the **oldest** one (lowest `created_at`) comes first — that's the one that's been waiting longest. Right now the newest ticket shows up first instead. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`sort_oldest_first(tickets: list[dict]) -> list[dict]`

**Example**
Tickets with `created_at` values `[3, 1, 2]` -> returned in order `[1, 2, 3]`.
